raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

A typo in `--dllm-algorithm-config` can pass unnoticed. For example, LowConfidence accepts `threshhold: 0.8` but still uses the default `threshold` of `0.95`. This PR rejects unknown keys at startup. The error names the algorithm and lists the supported keys.

Related to #39499, Phase 1: reject unknown algorithm configuration keys.

## Modifications

- Check config keys at startup for all four built-in dLLM algorithms.
- Also check keys in Gemma4Renoise's nested config sections.
- Accept `capture_input_preparation` only for algorithms that support it.
- Keep existing defaults. For Gemma4Renoise, a nested value still takes priority when the same option is set at the top level.
- Add CPU regression tests and update the docs.

## Accuracy Tests

The following tests passed in a Linux ARM64 Docker container with Python 3.12.14 and PyTorch 2.13.0+cpu: **54 tests and 45 subtests**, with no skips.

```bash
docker exec sglang-dllm-config-20261014 python -m pytest -v -p no:cacheprovider \
  test/registered/unit/dllm/test_config.py \
  test/registered/unit/dllm/algorithm/test_joint_threshold_indel.py \
  test/registered/unit/dllm/test_gemma4_renoise.py
```

Pre-commit passed for all changed files. The updated MDX page compiles, and the docs link check passed. `mint validate` fails on an existing syntax error in `docs/src/snippets/configs/popular-models.jsx:100`. That file is unchanged from `616081d`.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

No GPU model accuracy or performance tests were run. This change only validates configuration keys at startup and does not alter model execution, so these benchmarks are not applicable.

## Checklist

- [x] Format code with pre-commit.
- [x] Add focused unit tests.
- [x] Update documentation.
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmarks (not applicable to this config check).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.

+import tempfile
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import yaml
+
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase, maybe_stub_sgl_kernel
+
+maybe_stub_sgl_kernel()
+
+from sglang.srt.dllm.algorithm import get_algorithm
+from sglang.srt.dllm.config import DllmConfig
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestDllmConfig(CustomTestCase):
+    def _parse_config(self, algorithm, content):
+        architecture = (
+            "DiffusionGemmaForBlockDiffusion"
+            if algorithm == "Gemma4Renoise"
+            else "LLaDA2MoeModelLM"
+        )
+        model_config = SimpleNamespace(
+            hf_config=SimpleNamespace(
+                architectures=[architecture],
+                delete_token_id=156930,
+                split_token_id=156931,
+            ),
+            vocab_size=157184,
+        )
+        with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(mode="w", suffix=".yaml") as config_file:
+            config_file.write(content)
+            config_file.flush()
+            server_args = SimpleNamespace(
+                dllm_algorithm=algorithm,
+                dllm_algorithm_config=config_file.name,
+                model_path="local/diffusion-model",
+                revision=None,
+                max_running_requests=None,
+                dllm_fdfo=False,
+            )
+            with patch(
+                "sglang.srt.dllm.config.ModelConfig.from_server_args",
+                return_value=model_config,
+            ):
+                return DllmConfig.from_server_args(server_args)
+
+    def test_unknown_keys_list_the_supported_keys(self):
+        key = "threshhold"  # codespell:ignore threshhold
+        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as error:
+            self._parse_config("LowConfidence", yaml.safe_dump({key: 0.8}))
+        self.assertEqual(
+            str(error.exception),
+            f"Unknown configuration keys for LowConfidence: {key}. "
+            "Supported keys: block_size, threshold",
+        )
+
+    def test_keys_from_other_algorithms_are_rejected(self):
+        cases = (
+            ("LowConfidence", "edit_threshold"),
+            ("JointThreshold", "sampler_config"),
+            ("JointThresholdInDel", "penalty_lambda"),
+            ("JointThresholdInDel", "vectorized_decoding"),
+            ("Gemma4Renoise", "threshold"),
+        )
+        for algorithm, key in cases:
+            with self.subTest(algorithm=algorithm, key=key):
+                with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as error:
+                    self._parse_config(algorithm, yaml.safe_dump({key: 1}))
+                self.assertIn(
+                    f"Unknown configuration keys for {algorithm}: {key}. "
+                    "Supported keys: ",
+                    str(error.exception),
+                )
+
+    def test_unknown_gemma_keys_include_the_section(self):
+        cases = (
+            (
+                "sampler_config",
+                "entrophy_bound",  # codespell:ignore entrophy
+                "sampler_config.entropy_bound",
+            ),
+            (
+                "temperature_schedule",
+                "min_temperature",
+                "temperature_schedule.t_max, temperature_schedule.t_min",
+            ),
+            (
+                "stopping_config",
+                "confidence_treshold",  # codespell:ignore treshold
+                "stopping_config.confidence_threshold, "
+                "stopping_config.stability_threshold",
+            ),
+        )
+        for section, key, supported_keys in cases:
+            with self.subTest(section=section):
+                with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as error:
+                    self._parse_config(
+                        "Gemma4Renoise", yaml.safe_dump({section: {key: 1}})
+                    )
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    str(error.exception),
+                    f"Unknown configuration keys for Gemma4Renoise: {section}.{key}. "
+                    f"Supported keys: {supported_keys}",
+                )
+
+    def test_mixed_unknown_key_types_report_a_value_error(self):
+        with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as error:
+            self._parse_config(
+                "LowConfidence", yaml.safe_dump({7: 1, "extra_option": 2})
+            )
+        self.assertIn(
+            "Unknown configuration keys for LowConfidence: 7, extra_option. "
+            "Supported keys: ",
+            str(error.exception),
+        )
+
+    def test_input_preparation_option_requires_algorithm_support(self):
+        for algorithm in ("LowConfidence", "JointThreshold", "JointThresholdInDel"):
+            with self.subTest(algorithm=algorithm):
+                with self.assertRaises(ValueError) as error:
+                    self._parse_config(
+                        algorithm,
+                        yaml.safe_dump({"capture_input_preparation": True}),
+                    )
+                self.assertIn(
+                    f"Unknown configuration keys for {algorithm}: "
+                    "capture_input_preparation. Supported keys: ",
+                    str(error.exception),
+                )
+
+    def test_gemma_input_preparation_option(self):
+        for enabled in (False, True):
+            with self.subTest(enabled=enabled):
+                config = self._parse_config(
+                    "Gemma4Renoise",
+                    yaml.safe_dump({"capture_input_preparation": enabled}),
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(config.capture_input_preparation, enabled)
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    get_algorithm(config).use_graph_input_preparation, enabled
+                )
+
+    def test_valid_threshold_configs_reach_the_algorithm(self):
+        cases = (
+            ("LowConfidence", {"threshold": 0.8}),
+            (
+                "JointThreshold",
+                {
+                    "threshold": 0.7,
+                    "edit_threshold": 0.2,
+                    "max_post_edit_steps": 3,
+                    "penalty_lambda": 0.1,
+                    "vectorized_decoding": True,
+                },
+            ),
+            (
+                "JointThresholdInDel",
+                {
+                    "threshold": 0.6,
+                    "edit_threshold": 0.3,
+                    "max_post_edit_steps": 2,
+                },
+            ),
+        )
+        for name, values in cases:
+            with self.subTest(algorithm=name):
+                config = self._parse_config(
+                    name,
+                    yaml.safe_dump({**values, "block_size": 16}),
+                )
+                algorithm = get_algorithm(config)
+                self.assertEqual(config.block_size, 16)
+                self.assertEqual(algorithm.block_size, 16)
+                self.assertEqual(config.mask_id, 156895)
+                self.assertFalse(config.capture_input_preparation)
+                for key, value in values.items():
+                    self.assertEqual(getattr(algorithm, key), value)
+
+    def test_gemma_nested_values_override_flat_aliases(self):
+        config = self._parse_config(
+            "Gemma4Renoise",
+            yaml.safe_dump(
+                {
+                    "block_size": 16,
+                    "capture_input_preparation": False,
+                    "max_denoising_steps": 12,
+                    "seed": 42,
+                    "use_temperature_table": False,
+                    "t_min": 0.1,
+                    "t_max": 0.9,
+                    "confidence_threshold": 0.03,
+                    "stability_threshold": 3,
+                    "sampler_config": {"entropy_bound": 0.2},
+                    "temperature_schedule": {"t_min": 0.3, "t_max": 0.7},
+                    "stopping_config": {
+                        "confidence_threshold": 0.02,
+                        "stability_threshold": 2,
+                    },
+                }
+            ),
+        )
+        algorithm = get_algorithm(config)
+        self.assertEqual(algorithm.block_size, 16)
+        self.assertEqual(algorithm.max_denoising_steps, 12)
+        self.assertEqual(algorithm.seed, 42)
+        self.assertFalse(algorithm.use_temperature_table)
+        self.assertFalse(algorithm.use_graph_input_preparation)
+        self.assertEqual(algorithm.entropy_bound, 0.2)
+        self.assertEqual((algorithm.t_min, algorithm.t_max), (0.3, 0.7))
+        self.assertEqual(algorithm.confidence_threshold, 0.02)
+        self.assertEqual(algorithm.stability_threshold, 2)
+
+    def test_empty_yaml_preserves_defaults(self):
+        for name, threshold in (
+            ("LowConfidence", 0.95),
+            ("Gemma4Renoise", None),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(algorithm=name):
+                config = self._parse_config(name, "")
+                algorithm = get_algorithm(config)
+                self.assertEqual(config.algorithm_config, {})
+                self.assertEqual(config.max_running_requests, 1)
+                if threshold is not None:
+                    self.assertEqual(config.block_size, 32)
+                    self.assertEqual(algorithm.threshold, threshold)
+                else:
+                    self.assertEqual(config.block_size, 256)
+                    self.assertEqual(algorithm.max_denoising_steps, 48)
+                    self.assertEqual(algorithm.entropy_bound, 0.1)
+                    self.assertEqual((algorithm.t_min, algorithm.t_max), (0.4, 0.8))
+                    self.assertTrue(algorithm.use_graph_input_preparation)
+
+    def test_null_gemma_sections_preserve_defaults(self):
+        config = self._parse_config(
+            "Gemma4Renoise",
+            "sampler_config: null\ntemperature_schedule: null\nstopping_config: null\n",
+        )
+        algorithm = get_algorithm(config)
+        self.assertEqual(algorithm.entropy_bound, 0.1)
+        self.assertEqual((algorithm.t_min, algorithm.t_max), (0.4, 0.8))
+        self.assertEqual(algorithm.confidence_threshold, 0.005)
+        self.assertEqual(algorithm.stability_threshold, 1)
+
+    def test_non_mapping_yaml_keeps_the_existing_error(self):
+        with self.assertRaisesRegex(
+            ValueError, "The dLLM algorithm config must be a YAML mapping"
+        ):
+            self._parse_config("LowConfidence", "42\n")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

issue_comments.body:
Thanks, both earlier points are fixed. A few cases in `test_config.py` only repeat checks made elsewhere. Could we trim them?

- [`test_unknown_keys_list_the_supported_keys`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/d79264f5fa5dc0f92a6cc46f991e4497f9249358/test/registered/unit/dllm/test_config.py#L55-L80). One exact message is enough, since other cases already catch a wrong key list.
- [`test_mixed_unknown_key_types_report_a_value_error`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/d79264f5fa5dc0f92a6cc46f991e4497f9249358/test/registered/unit/dllm/test_config.py#L143-L147). Its nested value takes the same formatting path as the top-level one.
- [`test_input_preparation_option_requires_algorithm_support`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/d79264f5fa5dc0f92a6cc46f991e4497f9249358/test/registered/unit/dllm/test_config.py#L161). One `enabled` value is enough, and [the `assertNotIn`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/d79264f5fa5dc0f92a6cc46f991e4497f9249358/test/registered/unit/dllm/test_config.py#L174-L177) cannot fail once the key is rejected.
- [`test_gemma_flat_aliases_remain_fallbacks`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/d79264f5fa5dc0f92a6cc46f991e4497f9249358/test/registered/unit/dllm/test_config.py#L261-L287). Already covered by `test_gemma4_renoise.py` and the nested override case.
- [`test_absent_and_empty_yaml_preserve_defaults`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/d79264f5fa5dc0f92a6cc46f991e4497f9249358/test/registered/unit/dllm/test_config.py#L289-L310). One empty file per validator is enough, since `None` never reaches the new check.
- [`test_non_mapping_yaml_keeps_the_existing_error`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/d79264f5fa5dc0f92a6cc46f991e4497f9249358/test/registered/unit/dllm/test_config.py#L324). Only the `42` input can catch a reordered check.
